summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe-dev preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...` for the current platform/arch, chmod+x's it in a temp directory, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (character-code lookup array, array-rotation obfuscation via `function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, no readable URLs or strings — destinations are reconstructed at runtime from a numeric constant table). The `setup.mjs` module itself uses variable-obfuscated imports (`_0x488df8=fs`, `_0x52943e=https`). The advertised purpose of the package is a small frontend dev-helper whose `main` is a thin re-export of `./provide`; downloading an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute a large obfuscated sibling bundle is unrelated to that purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded runtime evades Node-based sandboxes and static scanners, and the payload behavior is opaque).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
